question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is '**includes**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**includes**" accurately fits the context, meaning that **the diet of elephants in captivity consists of some of the same foods that wild elephants eat. (शामिल करना)**
 
• This suggests that **the captivity diet partly overlaps with the natural diet of wild elephants.**
 
• The other options** ("subjugates," "invites," and "attracts") **do not appropriately fit the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Elephants in captivity will likely be fed a diet that includes__ some of the same foods that of a wild elephant.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Subjugates (अधीन करना)**: means to bring under domination or control, which does not fit the dietary context.
 
• **Invites (आमंत्रित करना)**: means to make a polite, formal, or friendly request, which does not suit the diet context.
 
• **Attracts (आकर्षित करना)**: means to draw by appeal, which also does not fit the context of describing a diet.
